title: Minimum Binary Decomposition of Decimal Strings
description:
A "deci-binary" number is a positive integer where each digit is either 0 or 1. Given a large decimal integer n (provided as a string), determine the minimum number of deci-binary numbers required to sum up to n.

Example 1
Input: n = "32"
Output: 3

Example 2
Input: n = "82734"
Output: 8
input_format: The first line contains a single string representing the decimal number n.
output_format: Print the minimum number of deci-binary components needed for the sum.
constraints:
1 <= n.length <= 100000
n contains only digits (0–9)
n has no leading zeros
